They are the architecture working exactly as designed — for a specific set of markets, and against yours. The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer convenient payment processing, but their restrictions on certain countries limit their usefulness for creators in Nigeria. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a comprehensive solution, including automatic crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is built using free and paid tools, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, giving creators a fully operational online store.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude certain countries due to regulatory or risk concerns, leaving creators in those regions without access to their services. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to be inclusive, allowing creators from any country to build and operate their own online stores. This approach ensures that creators in Nigeria and other restricted countries can participate in the global digital economy.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional payment platforms often charge high fees, and their payment processing times can be slow. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure leveraging cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin or Ethereum can offer fast payment processing and lower fees. For example, the Edge Commerce Stack uses NOWPayments, which charges a 0.5% fee and offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, reducing the risk of chargebacks and disputes.
Build your online store without restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators retain full ownership of their online stores and customer data. This approach also enables automation, allowing creators to focus on producing high-quality digital products. Instant product delivery is another key benefit, ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. This streamlined process enhances the overall customer experience and builds trust in the creator's brand.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.

The Edge Commerce Stack, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, provides a turnkey solution for digital creators, enabling them to build and operate their own online stores without relying on traditional payment platforms. This stack is designed to be easy to use and deploy, even for creators without extensive technical expertise.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, select a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, set up an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, configure a file delivery system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and integrate a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. Ensure that your online store is properly configured, tested, and secured to provide a seamless customer experience.
